messages:
sasha: Heads-up — release branch `release/v1.9.0` is blocked, build pipeline failing at `build-wheel`. We hit cutoff in 30m. Anyone able to triage?
ci-bot: Pipeline #4213 failed on job `build-wheel` (agent: linux-build-12). See: https://ci.redwood.internal/p/4213
jordan: copy of the last bit of the log: ```ERROR: failed to verify artifact wheel: checksum mismatch for gs://redwood-artifacts/wheels/pack-1.2.3.whl
 expected: sha256:7a1f...
 actual:   sha256:1b0c...
 aborting build.```
taylor: this smells like a cache restore problem — we've seen GCS object being re-uploaded by concurrent job once and it caused mismatch.
maria: can someone run a targeted artifact cache purge for that object? I can also re-run the build after. Command: `gsutil -m rm gs://redwood-artifacts/wheels/pack-1.2.3.whl` (will force rebuild)
sasha: what's the blast radius of purging that wheel? Any downstream consumers?
ops-oncall: pack-1.2.3 is used by canary and the dedicated test infra. Purging will force rebuilds but they should be deterministic. Recommend purge + immediate guarded rebuild on a build agent with isolated cache.
jordan: quick check — the offending commit touched the wheel build script to bump `wheel` version. Could be a race where two builders generated different metadata. Suggest pinning wheel build to commit hash while we triage.
taylor: agreed. Two-step: 1) label this thread `release-blocker`, 2) purge artifact, 3) re-run `build-wheel` in isolated agent, 4) if it reproduces consistently, revert the script change and open a hotfix PR.
sasha: ok I'm labeling and pausing the release. @maria please purge and re-run on `build-agent-23` (isolated). If it passes, we consider continuing; if it fails again, revert.
maria: running purge now... (starts)
ci-bot: Re-run requested: Pipeline #4214 triggered by maria — job `build-wheel` assigned to build-agent-23
deploy-bot: Deploy for `release/v1.9.0` aborted: release-blocker present (blocked by CI failures).
jordan: while that's running — quick workaround option is to pin dependency to the last known-good wheel (`pack==1.2.2`) in the release branch. That would unblock but is hacky. Would prefer fix+rebuild.
ops-oncall: if rebuild succeeds in <20m we can still meet cutoff. If not, we should plan rollback of the commit that touched the build script. Create PR `revert/build-script-bump` and draft release notes accordingly.
ci-bot: Pipeline #4214 `build-wheel` SUCCESS on build-agent-23 — artifact uploaded gs://redwood-artifacts/wheels/pack-1.2.3.whl (sha256:7a1f...)
maria: rebuild succeeded after purge. I compared metadata: the earlier object had incorrect `mtime` and a different wheel tag — looks like a parallel job accidentally wrote a non-deterministic artifact.
taylor: good catch. We should add a lock to the wheel publish step to avoid concurrent uploads. Filing an infra ticket: INFRA-782 "artifact publish lock for wheel uploads".
sasha: decision: continue with release after a gated canary deploy. Jordan/Taylor own the follow-ups (revert PR only if this regresses). I've updated the release window to +2h and noted the mitigation steps in the release doc.
jordan: marking follow-ups: pin deterministic build in CI config, add upload lock, add checksum verification step post-upload.
maria: I'll monitor canary and roll forward if green.
ops-oncall: added `release-blocker` label on the PRs and assigned oncall fallback.
sasha: thanks everyone — closing the blocker thread once canary is green. :thumbsup:
